items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: We made The Big Broadcast of 1936 with Eleanor Powell. Were you there?

ctx.x: Yeah, it's possible. A lot of people didn't care for Cab. Because Cab had a funny way about him. He was jealous of everybody...
It happened a little later, because I remember seeing... We made The Big Broadcast of 1936 with Eleanor Powell. Were you there?
